events.summary: Pack It In! is in Steam Next Fest until October 26, and we're reading everything you post this week. The Tight Fit Club The demo ends with a challenge: downsize your guests into rooms smaller than their quote. How small can you go? events.title: Demo 1.9: What's Changed Since Version 1
